decision_rule: ALTERNATION-POSITIVE only if tripod score >= 0.30, both group mean rates > 2 Hz, and both LF-RH and RF-LH correlations are negative. A positive result licenses only a further preregistered physical experiment; it is not walking and not a biological claim. All-negative must be reported as negative with no reframing.
limits: Open-loop neural replay only, no body, no contact, no sensorimotor loop. Scalars are uncalibrated engineering weights; the half-centre mechanism is a modelling hypothesis here, not a measurement of fly circuitry; the strict 20k subgraph is not the whole VNC. Nothing here is a lesion or surgical model.
